_comment: Click paths for the five peacetime actions on HOI4 1.19.5 (Windows, 1920x1080).
Hotkeys are names from HOTKEYS in adapters/input_driver.py (topbar.gui bindings).
set_national_focus, queue_construction's search and the keys of all five were run in the live game;
the click targets are yours to record: `hoi4-harness calibrate`, then `check-scripts`.
{focus_name}, {state_name}, {tech_folder} and the computed target research.tech_point are
derived from the action's arguments before any input is sent (adapters/ui_resolve.py).
No step presses Escape: with no panel open it opens the game menu. See docs/adapters.md.
set_production is a DRAFT: its click path has not been walked in the game.
